cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle dinner. Give our talking cupboard a napkin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the handle, then. I'll lay it out; you offer the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from.

reason: Share the napkin task after B practical obstacle and retain the cooperative soup offer as the next expression of ordinary hospitality; remove final explanatory complaint.
